scope.reason: Recompute the signing judge's name from the stored print page: a letter-spaced surname is now joined, and the name has no feature storage of its own. Read letter-spaced emphasis through the one shared reading, once a paragraph's lines are joined: a short spaced word in a text that spaces words, a row of one-letter words no sentence writes, and uneven chunks the document prints nowhere else read as the words they spell; only whitespace in block text changes and it has no feature storage of its own. Signature roles are recomputed from the stored decision through the shared Czech role grammar, which reads the office a judge signs under (the president or a member of an extended or grand chamber, the President of a top court); they have no feature storage of their own. Roles are recomputed from the stored print page: the judge signs above the office's certification of the copy (Za správnost vyhotovení), which carries no role, and the bench recital that leads in the ruling is intro. Roles have no feature storage of their own. Printed paragraph labels are read by one grammar: a label opens a paragraph except inside a date wrapped after its day or after a word its number belongs to, sub-paragraphs (`5.5.`) open their own and count as items beside the court's numbering, and positioned-line paragraphs are read by the one line-join owner; block text, boundaries and numbers are recomputed from stored raw and have no feature storage of their own. Roles are recomputed from stored raw: a bench recital printed before a takto: of its own line (Ústavní soud České republiky / v senátě rozhodl ve věci …) is intro, through the one shared Czech recital rule. Roles have no feature storage of their own.
